title: Inside Lincoln Heights' Massive 1,700 Backpack Giveaway
description:
Back-to-school shopping is tougher than ever, but Lincoln Heights isn't letting high prices hold students back. Council District 1 recently stepped up to host its third annual backpack giveaway, bringing massive relief to local families.

Volunteers handed out 1,700 brand-new backpacks stuffed with essential school supplies like notebooks and pencils. Dozens of local organizations joined the drive, connecting parents directly to vital housing and health services.

With rent and uniform costs soaring, the event aimed to lighten the heavy financial load before the first school bell rings. Beyond the supplies, the rally proved that community spirit is the ultimate weapon for student success.
